downside.story: P10: AI optics digestion in CY2027-28 (the standing capex file's low case has 2028 customer capex below 2027) plus share loss to Chinese 1.6T module makers: D&C capture -22% (FY28 D&C ~9.4B), D&C margin -2.5pt (back to the FY25-26 24-25% band with under-absorbed new InP fabs), Industrial -8% (semicap turn), and the multiple derates 6 turns to ~13x, where COHR traded on FY24 trough earnings, plus one more turn for the Marvell-Lumentum low variant (Marvell DSP+laser+module bundle takes COHR sockets: run-rate op income -84 instead of +136, about -$10/share vs the base adjustment, ~1 turn on downside EPS). Mid-cycle EPS -25%.

upside.story: P90: InP capacity more than doubles on time in CY2027, CPO light sources and OCS add on top (management TAMs >$15B and >$4B), D&C capture +15% (FY28 D&C ~13.8B) and margin +1.5pt toward the >42% gross-margin target; multiple +5 turns to ~24x (CIEN level) plus one turn for the Marvell-Lumentum high variant (hyperscalers dual-source away from a Marvell-owned Lumentum: FY2030 +1,299 revenue, about +$19/share vs the base adjustment, ~1 turn on upside EPS). Mid-cycle EPS +15%.

downside.story: P10: a 2027-28 AI-optics digestion (LightCounting 'Bumpy Ride' / supply-chain correction) arrives as the InP shortage ends; Innolight/Eoptolink keep taking share (Eoptolink already passed COHR for #2 in 2025); D&C capture -25%, D&C margin -3pt on module price cuts, Industrial -10%; NTM P/E ~12.3x company basis: -6 turns trough optics multiple plus ~-1 turn for the Marvell-Lumentum low variant (Marvell DSP+EML+module bundle takes COHR sockets: FY2030 revenue -282 vs base +234, ~-$12/share against the base adjustment).

upside.story: P90: 6-inch InP doubling lands on time and capture stops falling, NVIDIA commitments pull 1.6T and CPO laser volume forward, D&C margin +1.5pt; NTM P/E ~25.8x: +5 turns toward the peer high end plus ~+1.5 turns for the Marvell-Lumentum high variant (dual-sourcing away from a Marvell-owned Lumentum: FY2030 revenue +1,299 vs base +234, ~+$27/share).

downside.story: P10: AI-optics digestion plus share loss. D&C capture -30% vs base (FY28 D&C ~8.1B instead of ~11.2B: 1.6T ASP erosion as Innolight/Eoptolink add capacity, Marvell-Lumentum bundle wins sockets, a 2028 capex pause starts to be priced), D&C margin -4pt (fab under-absorption of the new 6-inch InP capacity, inventory write-downs on the 2.58B stock), Industrial -10%, exit P/E -7 turns (12.25x; -6 for digestion/CPO plus ~-1 for the Marvell-Lumentum low variant) and normalized EPS -25%. Stock ~$111.

upside.story: P90: capacity doubling lands on time, 1.6T and CPO laser (NVIDIA UHP CW) volumes pull forward, independent-supplier share gain after Marvell-Lumentum: D&C capture +22%, margin +2pt (gross margin reaches the >42% goal), exit P/E +7 turns (26.25x; +6 plus ~+1 for the Marvell-Lumentum high variant: hyperscalers dual-source away from a Marvell-owned Lumentum), normalized EPS +25%. Stock ~$455, just above the 52-week high of $440.

downside.story: P10: LightCounting's 'bumpy ride' correction arrives in CY2027-28 (it already calls the supply chain 'clearly overreacting' and assumes only +50% capex in 2027) while new module capacity (Innolight, Eoptolink, later Luxshare/Dongshan) and CPO/NPO pilots cut pluggable pricing: D&C capture -25% (FY28 D&C ~9.0B instead of 12.0B), D&C margin -3pt (back to ~24%, below FY26 25.2% on under-absorbed 6-inch InP capacity), Industrial -10% and -2pt on a semicap turn; the P/E de-rates 6 turns to 14x as the market prices a cyclical peak and the cash burn (FY26 FCF -1.02B, five OCF misses) persists. Marvell bundle takes COHR transceiver share (appraisal low variant). Multiple -6 turns = -5.25 cyclical de-rate + -0.75 for the Marvell-Lumentum low variant (-$9.46/share: run-rate op income -84 vs +136, x 0.81 x 19.15 / 1.11^2.66 x 0.75 / 204.9; / blended EPS 12.87); mid-cycle EPS -20% (NTM revenue base ~21% lower with capture -25%).

upside.story: P90: InP doubling lands a quarter early again (PhotonCap), the Marvell DSP and 200G EML bottlenecks that held back 2026 1.6T shipments clear (cnyes), Innolight-style 2027 order acceleration flows to COHR lasers and modules, CPO laser-source volume from the NVIDIA commitment adds on top; capture +18%, D&C margin +2pt on 6-inch cost (4x devices at half the cost per device); customers dual-source away from a Marvell-owned Lumentum (appraisal high variant); P/E re-rates 6 turns to 26x, near the peer median plus growth premium. Multiple +6.4 = +4.5 re-rate + 1.9 for the Marvell-Lumentum high variant (+$24.47/share at run-rate +705 vs +136); mid-cycle EPS +12% on the higher revenue base.

downside.story: P10 ($120): an AI-optics digestion year lands inside the horizon NTM (FY28), like 2019 (LightCounting Ethernet transceivers -18%) on a much bigger base, with the standing capex low case (2028 1,265B vs 2,255B base) and Polymarket's 'AI downturn by 2027-06-30' (23%) as the trigger; D&C capture -30% (Chinese module makers and LITE capacity land as demand pauses), D&C margin -3pt (absorption), Industrial -10% (Kalshi 2027 recession 20%), Marvell-Lumentum low variant (~-$10/share vs base), and the P/E derates 6.5 turns to ~12.6x, the 2022-23 optics-trough area. Base rate: of 7 optical-name episodes since 2008 with the stock >=40% below its 12-month high, 3 fell a further 20-52% over the next 12 months.

upside.story: P90 ($460): InP output doubles by Dec-26 and again in 2027 on time, NVIDIA and hyperscaler LTAs keep FY27-28 capture near FY26 levels (+22%), mix/absorption add 2pt, the Marvell-Lumentum high variant (customers dual-source away from Marvell, ~+$32/share if close) starts to show, and the multiple recovers toward the own 5-year median (26.1x company basis). Base rate: the same 7 episodes include +67%, +81% and +212% 12-month rebounds (COHR Dec-08, LITE May-19, COHR Oct-23).

downside.story: P10 (~$120): AI-optics digestion in CY2028 (standing capex file low case: 2028 customer capex 1,265 $B, below 2027's 1,390; LightCounting 'Bumpy Ride') plus 1.6T price pressure: D&C capture -22%, D&C margin -2.5pt (back to the FY26 ~25% band on under-absorbed 6-inch InP fabs), Industrial -8%, mid-cycle EPS -25%; P/E -6 turns (COHR's trough-year multiple range ~13x), -0.57 turns because the fixed $0.88 Zacks gap is a larger share of lower EPS, and -1.04 turns = -$9.73/share for the Marvell-Lumentum low variant (adjustment -829 instead of +1,164). About -43% from spot.

upside.story: P90 (~$421): InP capacity more than doubles on time in CY2027, capex-file high case (2027 2,434 / 2028 3,160 $B), CPO light sources and OCS add on top: capture +15%, D&C margin +1.5pt toward the >42% gross-margin target, mid-cycle EPS +15%; P/E +5 turns (~24-25x, CIEN/MTSI range), +0.23 turns for the smaller basis gap at higher EPS, +1.57 turns = +$24.56/share for the Marvell-Lumentum high variant (adjustment 6,197). About +100% from spot.
